name: AEC Drawing Intelligence - notify QC lead (webhook)

parameters.subject: ={{ '[AEC QC] ' + $json.body.project + ': ' + ($json.body.status === 'ok' ? $json.body.high + ' high-severity potential discrepancies' : 'run failed') }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Project: ' + $json.body.project + '
Status: ' + $json.body.status + '
Findings: ' + $json.body.findings + ' (' + $json.body.high + ' high, ' + $json.body.needs_review + ' needs review)
Redlines not incorporated: ' + $json.body.markups_not_incorporated + '
Unreadable pages: ' + $json.body.unreadable_pages + '
Issue log: ' + $json.body.issue_log + '
Marked-up set: ' + $json.body.review_pdf + '

All items are potential discrepancies for engineer review.' }}

meta.aecdi_usage: Run the watcher as a service: aecdi watch <inbox> --out <out> --interval 300 --notify-url https://<n8n-host>/webhook/aecdi-run . Replace the example e-mail addresses and attach SMTP credentials to the Email node.
